title: First local comparison component
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an open, T a closed subset contained in U, and V = X minus T. With derived restriction and direct image [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image], for every adjunction restriction ⊣ R(U.ι)_* and every E whose cohomology stalks vanish outside T, the adjunction unit at E becomes invertible on both U and V.

source.place: Tag 08DF (Lemma 20.33.6), restriction computations using Tags 08FE and 08BS

proof.text: The underived open direct image is fully faithful by Modules.restrictAdjunction. Its exact left adjoint makes it preserve K-injectives. The proved full_rightDerivedFunctor and faithful_rightDerivedFunctor instances give full faithfulness of schemeDerivedDirectImage. Hence any supplied adjunction has invertible counit; its left triangle identity makes derived scheme restriction of the unit invertible. The exact derived over-site equivalence and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso reflect this to the stated over-site restriction.

Exact restriction commutes with homology. Modules.overFunctorEquiv and restrictStalkNatIso identify every stalk of the homology of E restricted to U with its original stalk. Thus the support hypothesis passes from E to its scheme restriction.

For an arbitrary direct image of an object supported over the closed T, restrict the source to the inverse image of X minus T. Supported derived restriction makes it zero; transport through the derived over-site equivalence. Open base change identifies target restriction with derived direct image of this zero object, hence zero. Exact homology and stalk comparisons recover support of the direct image.

Both E and the direct image of its restriction are therefore zero after over-site restriction to V. Any map between zero objects is invertible. Split W = U or W = V and combine with the triangle-identity proof on U. Empty opens and empty T use the same arguments.

proof_origin.based_on: Stacks Tags 08DF, 08FE, 08BS and 00A7; complete Lean proofs using exact restriction, stalk comparisons, and adjoint uniqueness.

theorem supported_open_pushforward_local_comparisons_first (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTU : T ⊆ (U : Set X))
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : (V : Set X) = Tᶜ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))] :
    (∀ (adj : ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι)
        (E : schemeDerivedCategory X),
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj E).val.presheaf x))) →
      ∀ W : X.Opens, W = U ∨ W = V →
        IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) W).mapDerivedCategory.map (adj.unit.app E)))
